title: Cluster values at every interior point of the complex \texorpdfstring{$\ell^p$}{ell-p} ball
established: Every value of a character over an interior point of the complex $\ell^p$ ball is a weak cluster value in the same ball, for $1<p<\infty$. The exact tail-radius estimate and origin approximation are proved directly.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Cluster-value equality at every interior point of the complex ell-p ball, for all 1<p<infinity.
